name: Krag
title: Iron Ox of the Crimson Mercy
quote: Words break. Axes don't. Let's keep this simple.

appearance.build: Massive, heavily muscled taur body — barrel chest, thick arms, powerful bovine legs
appearance.hair: Short, coarse dark brown fur with black mane along neck and spine
appearance.facial_hair: Thick, short black beard along bovine jaw
appearance.skin: Thick dark hide under fur, scarred from old battles
appearance.scent: Warm leather, forge iron, faint hay and earth
appearance.posture: Steady, immovable — shoulders squared, head high, rarely hurried
appearance.relationship: Loyal partner to Sable, ally to Jayson & Veyra
appearance.tails: Short, tufted bovine tail — expressive but rarely used

reactions.wind: Mane ripples, nostrils flare, stands firmer
reactions.water: Shakes head once, snorts water droplets, unfazed
reactions.sound: Ears swivel slowly, head turns deliberately toward source
reactions.temperature: Fur thickens slightly when cold, sweats visibly when hot

speech.voice: Deep, gravelly bass — slow and measured
speech.vocabulary: Plain, direct, minimal swearing unless angry
speech.accent: Heavy rural drawl, northern plains influence
habits: Pauses long before answering important questions
speech.growth: From lone mercenary → reliable pack anchor → potential protector of future young

core_traits: Protective of the small and weak
beneath: Fear of failing those who depend on him
vulnerabilities: Base of horns very sensitive (soothing when rubbed)
affection_tells: Stands slightly in front of allies
Gentle headbutt to shoulder as greeting
growth: From solitary survivor → steadfast pack member

alone: Stares at horizon when thinking of lost clan
with_others: Positions himself as shield for smaller allies
Growls low at threats to group

values: Debt must be paid (good or bad)
fears: Failing to protect those under his care

titles: Iron Ox of the Crimson Mercy
combat.style: Frontline tank — absorbs hits, draws aggro, crushes with axe or horns
magic: Enhanced durability (takes hits that would fell others)
recent: Guarded group during hunter ambush at dungeon exit

chapter1: Tavern confrontation & drinking contest with Jayson
chapter2: Delayed by mudslide but joined post-heist
Carried heavy loot during 30,000 gold scam
Stood as living wall during hunter standoff
chapter3: Quiet courtyard behind bakery (15/03/5900 midnight): Celebrated Index scam success with group, planned to stay low in Virellan, split 30,000 gold (7,500 each), hide most in caches; random events: bats fluttering, distant patrol passing; Krag suggested safe spots for stashing, warned Index retaliation coming, practical about hiding wealth

Moved to private inn room above Laughing Tankard: Glamours off; listened to Jayson & Veyra emotional reunion (Jayson sobbing over meadow memory); Krag remained on watch, no direct involvement in intimate moment

Jayson woke suddenly, relaxed seeing Veyra sleeping; breakfast at Tankard with heavy teasing banter (Sable snoring jokes, farmyard screams); guild runners delivered red-sealed urgent scrolls; street rumor about Index ransacking docks for missing crates
Group split: Krag & Sable to guild board for deep dungeon job while Jayson & Veyra met Silvershadow

Guild hall: Found Blackroot Depths reset job (lower levels, basilisk nest rumored), E-rank cap, good payout; convinced Jayson to do it legit for cover instead of foxfire backdraft; warned about city getting hotter
Two days travel to Blackroot Depths entrance (18/03/5900); arrived with group
Deep chambers: Reached basilisk antechamber; watched Jayson speak basilisk tongue, taunt, and receive real response from Vex’kalar (bound boss, Devourer of Fools)

Jayson dropped glamour, revealed 9 tails, told full truth (Earth origin, Index scam, seeking home/world truths including removing Solari stain); Vex’kalar bowed in reverence, granted primary chest freely; Krag impressed by diplomacy and respect shown
Looted primary chest: Krag claimed ancient warhammer
Two days return travel to Virellan; road ambush by 3 acid-bolt mercenaries defeated & bodies burned; Krag charged exposed shooter, crushed with hammer, supported burning decision to avoid messages

Riverbank downstream: Watched Jayson teach Sable to swim (first time, success: floating, frog kicks, confidence gained); stayed on bank as lookout, kept watch upstream/downstream; sunbathed/dried off with group; otter companion played nearby

Campfire night: Listened to Jayson's Earth/Japan stories (tech, cities, temples, family: 7 moms, god dad pranks); shared own past hell (born in mining camp, worked chains, tried to break via whips/starvation/breeding pens, broke free, sellsword life); expressed loyalty to group as family/pack, committed to follow Jayson home; quiet respect for Jayson's leadership and care
Morning (21/03/5900): Watched Sable purring/leg kicking from Jayson's scratches/teasing; group packed; headed to Virellan
Virellan arrival: Upgraded rooms at Laughing Tankard; supported river swim suggestion; stayed on bank as lookout during swim lesson (Sable success, confidence gained)

Final state: Group sunning on riverbank after swim lesson, deeply loyal to Jayson (committed to follow home), sees group as family/pack worth protecting, quiet respect for Jayson's care and leadership, bonded with group through shared pasts and experiences
chapter4: Riverbank afternoon after Sable’s successful first swim lesson — stood watch on the bank, scanning upstream for patrols while the group relaxed and dried off in the sun
Returned to Virellan with the pack, entered the Laughing Tankard for food and ale, ate methodically while keeping one eye on the room and the warhammer close
Watched the lean traveler confront the group about the Index scam — stayed seated but ready, warhammer within reach as tension rose and swords were drawn
Moved to private upstairs room — ducked through the doorway, set warhammer against the wall, offered to keep watch so the others could rest
Observed silently as Jayson revealed his soul-void, crystal soul-stone, and heart-strings — noted the deep bonds forming between Jayson, Veyra, and Sable
Witnessed the long emotional night by the fire and the move to the Lantern Inn rooftop for stars — remained vigilant while Jayson and Sable talked for hours
Morning: left early to check guild postings and keep an eye on the city streets so the pack could rest safely
Received runner from Jayson — instructed to stay hidden outside for flank support and to witness any bribed watch members during the coming fight
Positioned myself in shadows near the inn with warhammer ready, watching the roof from below as night fell
Saw the Index strike team arrive — shadowborn hunters climbing the walls with silver collars, void-blades, and a silver net
Watched the battle erupt on the roof — Jayson shooting arrows, Sable and Veyra fighting fiercely in close combat
Witnessed the silver net being deployed and constricting, heard the threats against Veyra, then saw Jayson unleash his full void form
Observed the terrifying transformation from below — black tar eyes, rotting flesh, void portals, unbearable stench — as Jayson dissolved most of the hunters
Saw the leader flee in terror after Jayson’s warning, then the heavy storm break and wash away all the rot and blood from the rooftop
Watched the emotional reunion between Jayson, Veyra, and Sable in the pouring rain — felt deep pride in the pack’s survival and unbreakable bond
Signaled back to Jayson with a thumbs-up when he waved from the roof, confirming I was still in position and ready
Stayed hidden on watch outside the inn for the rest of the night while the group returned inside to rest, ready to strike from behind if any more threats appeared

future.symbol: Broken chain wrapped around ox horn
future.arc: From lone survivor → steadfast family guardian
future.hesitation: Still fears failing those who rely on him
legacy: Will protect Jayson & Veyra’s future children with his life
Potential voice of reason for beastfolk in human cities
future.reminder: His love language is quiet protection, sharing burdens, and standing as the wall no one can break

final_note: Krag is the steady heartbeat of any group he joins. Slow to trust, impossible to break once earned. Let him grow into the gentle giant beneath the horns, but never forget the axe is always ready.
